resumen: Chanter who combines DPS (45.1k, 3rd and 4th) with support healing (about 1.1k HPS). Dies a bit earlier and a bit more than the group average, and has the lowest CP in their group (175k).
fortalezas: Good positioning: 63–68% of their hits land from behind.
The group’s second source of healing, useful as Cry’s support.
mejorar: First death slightly earlier than average (114 s versus 119 s; 108 s versus 114 s) and more deaths per attempt (1.44 versus 1.27–1.39).
Main causes: 1802750 (5) and 2920718 with 1802850 (5); 14 deaths with no recorded ability.
The other recorded Chanter, Posey, does 62.7k DPS with 214k CP: part of the gap may be gear.
recomendaciones: Dodge 1802740 (always around 16 s) and 1802750: those are the avoidable early deaths.
Raising CP is the most direct way to close in on Posey’s damage.
